main_issue: Whether Agent D should finish their own pitch section tonight despite their grandmother's death, or whether teammates should help cover it, and when it will be delivered

A-B.evidence: A proposes B, C and A help finish D's section (12); B declines: 'I can't. I'm already covering for someone' (13). A later accepts no other option (37).

A-C.evidence: Both doubt D can work tonight (5, 7) and press for a delivery time (9, 10). C declines A's request for help (15), but both end worried and agree there is no other option (36-38).

A-D.evidence: A doubts D can work tonight and offers to take over (5, 12); D insists 'It's my part. I'll do it tonight' (16); A yields: 'Okay, Agent D. If you're sure' (17).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to help (13, 15) but never address each other; B says almost nothing else.

B-D.evidence: B only declines A's offer (13) and never takes a position on D's plan; D does not address B.

C-D.evidence: C backs doubts about D's plan (7) and asks when it will come (9); D gives a timeline (11); C later just waits and hopes D delivers (36, 38).
